retained_learning: A future held-out forecast is scoreable only after a genuinely independent holder and predictor provide immutable, externally checkable commitments and no-outcome-access evidence before any source retrieval.
When those independent surfaces are absent, stop before source selection and preserve every outcome-bearing effect count at zero; this is correct control behavior, not forecast evidence.
The current same-task Work context cannot self-attest to predictor isolation after exposure to task and outcome-bearing summaries.
A contaminated historical forecast remains FAIL and cannot be repaired or replaced by a later fail-closed trial.
Unit PASS, live-trial evaluability, task and user verdicts, Candidate state, production routing, independent external capability, AGI, and user completion are separate claims.
Request-time provenance is immutable: later workflow, CI, PR, merge, readback, or user-input facts belong to subsequent safe boundaries and must not be backfilled.
